'''Esuma''' (Essouma) is an extinct language of uncertain classification within the [[Kwa language|Kwa]] branch of the [[Niger–Congo languages|Niger–Congo]] family, once spoken in the villages of [[Assinie-Mafia|Assinie (Asini) and Mafia]] in [[Ivory Coast]]. The Esuma were vassals of the [[Kingdom of Sanwi|Sanwi]] capital [[Krinjabo]], and shifted to the [[Anyin language|Anyin]] and [[Nzima language|Nzima]] languages.
